responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines the automaton scheduler model for the original Cavium ThunderX microarchitecture. It describes ThunderX’s dual-issue scalar pipes plus separate multiply, divide, and SIMD resources, and provides reservation and latency data for integer ALU, shifts, multiply/divide, loads/stores, branches, scalar FP, AdvSIMD/NEON, crypto, and table-lookup operations, including bypasses and special long-latency modeling, so tuning for "thunderx" reflects that core’s specific execution throughput and hazards.
